turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I'm here about Owen's zero. Who decided on it?
Fine. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Gracious isn't why I'm here, Hale. What do you have?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. I haven't seen a single document yet, and you want the zero to stand.
